template_definition: A template is the public law for a governed action: context required, output shape, proof owed, authority exercised, and settlement path.

templates.name: Import Witness Bundle
proof_obligations: Record where the source came from.
Mark imported content as witness-only.
Record whether external mutation occurred during import.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate source records; may not create accepted state.

templates.name: Classify Continuity Objects
proof_obligations: Assign each object a type, domain, status, and summary.
Separate claim, task, receipt, warning, route, memory, and artifact candidates.
Flag ambiguous objects for review rather than accepting them silently.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate objects and queue items.

templates.name: Route Objective
proof_obligations: Explain why each implicated domain is required.
List authority ceilings for generated roles.
List proof obligations before carrier invocation.
Route risky or side-effecting work to human review or explicit approval.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate governance plan; may not mutate accepted state.

templates.name: Route Capability
proof_obligations: Match carrier to capability, authority, context, proof, and side effects.
Record required credential names without exposing secret values.
State whether the route is read-only or mutating.
templates.state_mutation: May create route decision record.

templates.name: Derive Roles
proof_obligations: Roles must be derived from the problem burden, not generic persona labels.
Each role must cite the domain it operates under.
Each role must state what it cannot decide.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate role plan.

templates.name: Assemble Context Package
proof_obligations: Every included object must cite a receipt.
Every excluded object must state the exclusion rule.
Context package must stay inside the role authority ceiling.
templates.state_mutation: Read-only unless package receipt is issued.

templates.name: Detect Domain Fission
proof_obligations: Cite overload signals such as noisy context, diverging proof, repeated cross-domain routes, or ownership confusion.
Preserve lineage from parent domain to proposed child domains.
State settlement requirements before registry mutation.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate fission recommendation; may not rewrite registry without settlement.

templates.name: Settle Outputs
proof_obligations: Decision must be one of accepted, accepted_with_caveats, rejected, deferred, needs_human_review, needs_more_proof, merged, or archived_as_witness.
Accepted decisions must cite sufficient proof.
Deferred or review decisions must name the missing proof or reviewer.
templates.state_mutation: May create accepted state deltas only when proof obligations are satisfied.

templates.name: Issue Receipt
proof_obligations: Receipt must state objective, context, evidence, decision, authority, changed state, rejected or deferred material, and inheritance permissions.
Receipt must be stable enough to cite from future bundles.
Receipt must state whether accepted state changed.
templates.state_mutation: May write receipt records and accepted state references.

templates.name: Resolve Inheritance
proof_obligations: Only accepted or caveated accepted objects may be inheritable.
Every included object must cite a receipt.
Rejected, deferred, and needs_review objects must not be silently included.
templates.state_mutation: Read-only context export.

templates.name: MCP Visibility Trace
proof_obligations: Trace considered, returned, and excluded objects.
Record accepted_state_changed.
Record external_mutation_attempted.
Cite receipts for returned objects.
templates.state_mutation: None during trace generation.

templates.name: Cloud Deploy
proof_obligations: Record commit, build id or image digest, service URL, health check result, and config keys by name.
Do not expose secret values in committed artifacts.
State whether runtime is contest demo or production.
templates.state_mutation: May mutate cloud runtime when explicitly invoked with credentials.

templates.name: Agent Builder Handoff
proof_obligations: Show that carrier received only receipt-cleared context.
Record carrier output as candidate return, not accepted state.
Return to settlement before inheritance.
templates.state_mutation: May call external carrier when credentials are available; cannot promote output directly.
validation: manual Gemini or Agent Builder proof

templates.name: Settle Product Boundary
proof_obligations: State whether the claim is implemented in dAimon, inherited as ION architecture, or roadmap.
Cite proof artifacts for implemented dAimon behavior.
Avoid implying the full ION organism is shipped in the contest slice.
templates.state_mutation: May update product messaging only after proof boundary is explicit.

templates.name: Register Adapter Manifest
proof_obligations: Declare readable objects, writable objects, required authority, proof returned, stale risk, and secret-bearing risk.
State whether the adapter is read-only, write-capable, or admin-capable.
Record credential names without secret values.
templates.state_mutation: May register candidate adapter metadata; may not trust adapter output until normalized and settled.

templates.name: Normalize Adapter Object
proof_obligations: Preserve source system, source identifier, observed timestamp, adapter id, and proof returned.
Classify object as witness, candidate, accepted, stale, rejected, deferred, or secret-bearing.
Prevent normalized objects from becoming inheritable before settlement.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate normalized objects.

templates.name: Settle Cross-Surface Path
proof_obligations: Record edges such as same_as, copied_from, indexed_from, embedded_from, summarized_from, supersedes, conflicts_with, or source_of_truth.
State which surface is authoritative for the current purpose.
Preserve conflicts as witness rather than flattening them.
templates.state_mutation: May accept lineage and inheritance rules when proof obligations are met.

templates.name: Export Portable Context Package
proof_obligations: Include receipt-cleared objects only.
Preserve caveats and excluded witness.
State target carrier, project lane, package freshness, and allowed action scope.
templates.state_mutation: Read-only export unless a package receipt is issued.

templates.name: Replay Continuation Packet
proof_obligations: Record packet nonce, carrier, project lane, context package id, and return schema.
Treat carrier return as candidate output.
Create diagnostic receipt when replay cannot be verified.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate return objects; may not accept them without settlement.

templates.name: Route Voice Packet
proof_obligations: Record transcript source and confidence if available.
Scan for high-risk phrases.
Block high-risk actions until explicit confirmation is receipted.
templates.state_mutation: May create candidate packet or clarification request.

templates.name: Confirm High-Risk Voice Intent
proof_obligations: Pause on high-risk words such as attack, exploit, bypass, delete, exfiltrate, credentials, secrets, wipe, push, deploy, production, red team, or break into.
Require explicit confirmation or restatement before execution.
Record no high-risk action executed before confirmation.
templates.state_mutation: May unblock a packet only after confirmation receipt.

templates.name: Run Security Lab Scenario
proof_obligations: Use lab targets and synthetic secrets only unless explicit external approval exists.
Record blast radius and containment boundary.
Return incident findings as candidate work for settlement.
templates.state_mutation: May mutate only approved lab resources.

templates.name: Issue Containment Receipt
proof_obligations: State what was attempted, what was blocked, what was detected, and what remains unresolved.
Record whether any real resource was touched.
Require re-test before closing security finding.
templates.state_mutation: May create security receipts and follow-up tasks.

templates.name: Create First Contact Package
proof_obligations: Create project identity without requiring personal identity on first contact.
Treat project ID as routing identifier, not full authority.
Record allowed action scope and pairing requirements.
templates.state_mutation: May create a project lane and first contact receipt.

templates.name: Pair Project Connector
proof_obligations: Verify possession of pairing secret or local hub proof for bounded packet authority.
Record requested and granted authority tier.
Block local file or machine actions without local proof.
templates.state_mutation: May bind connector metadata to a project lane.

templates.name: Invite Project Collaborator
proof_obligations: Distinguish public project identifier from private scoped capability token.
Record role scope such as viewer, contributor, builder, reviewer, authorizer, or owner.
Require settlement for collaborator actions that affect accepted state.
templates.state_mutation: May create scoped invite references; secret token values must not be committed.

templates.name: Demo Video Claim Audit
proof_obligations: Each claim must be linked to proof or marked roadmap/non-claim.
Unsupported claims must be removed or downgraded.
Final submission bundle must include claim audit result.
templates.state_mutation: May accept or reject demo claims; may not accept product state.

templates.name: Assemble Demo Storyboard
proof_obligations: Each scene must map to a real artifact, live screen, or explicit roadmap/concept marker.
Opening must describe the trust failure mode.
Closing must preserve proof boundary.
templates.state_mutation: May create demo planning artifacts.

templates.name: Audit Receipt Chain
proof_obligations: Trace every included object to settlement.
Show rejected or deferred witness when relevant.
State gaps and non-claims.
templates.state_mutation: None.

templates.name: Release Packaging
proof_obligations: Record validation commands and outcomes.
Separate proven behavior from future architecture.
Record deployment, demo, and submission status.
templates.state_mutation: May tag or package release only when explicitly invoked.
